# Fenced status fixture

This plan documents the header format without carrying one. The only `**Status:**` line below sits
inside a fenced example, so it is illustrative markdown rather than this plan's own lifecycle state —
reading it as real would classify an unstarted plan as finished and offer it to the archive gate.

```md
**Status:** done
```

Everything outside the fence is prose, and this folder has no status of its own.
